Photo 1: Back view of the camera showing the LCD screen, control buttons (MENU, INFO, Av, SET, etc.), and the 'Canon' logo on the bottom bezel. The screen is off and reflects surroundings.
Photo 2: Side view of the camera showing the 'EOS 100D' model name engraved on the body. The lens is attached, and the camera body is white. The background shows a metal railing and tiled floor.
